set.body:
Scope:
Add a scheduler-neutral TaskSubmission carrying operation, input, submission key, ExecutionRequirements, and an optional PlacementClass. Preserve the existing submit(op, input, key) form as default-requirement compatibility sugar.

Initial model:
- ExecutionShape.SingleProcess(threads).
- Optional total memory, scratch, walltime, and typed accelerator requirements.
- No nodes, Slurm tasks, ranks, or MPI claims until Sojourn has an execution contract for them.
- Requirements live on each submission; operation-level defaults or input estimators are DSL sugar rather than operation identity.

Acceptance criteria:
- sojourn-core contains the complete portable model and imports no scala-slurm type.
- Every public quantity has validated construction and unambiguous units/semantics.
- SubmitRejection distinguishes unsupported, unsatisfiable, invalid-combination, placement, conflict, and closed cases without stringly sentinel fields.
- Same key plus different requirements or placement conflicts; identical submission attaches idempotently.
- Local execution either honors a supported requirement or rejects it explicitly; no non-default requirement is ignored.
- Existing default submissions remain source-compatible through documented overloads or migration helpers.
- Core, local, DSL, codec, and TCK tests cover defaults, invalid quantities, unsupported features, conflicts, and equality laws.
set.title: SOJ.R1: Introduce portable TaskSubmission and execution requirements
